synopsis: After a time skip into the reconstruction era, Falanaras has entered full martial service and begun training as a spellbreaker under the broader magical climate shaped by Grand Magister Rommath. The opening grounds the changes since the invasion: Kael’thas returned, destroyed the corrupted Sunwell with Rommath and Astalor, named the survivors sin’dorei, and departed in search of aid, leaving Lor’themar to govern in his absence. Silvermoon now rebuilds amid grief, visible fel crystals, euphemized arcane withdrawal, and the brittle discipline of a people who refuse to name desperation plainly. Concern is often shown through an offered mana source, a glance at shaking hands, or the choice to move a conversation nearer an active ward. In districts like Murder Row and beyond the city’s order, desperation already shows its ugliest face, while the promise of Kael’thas’s eventual return keeps hope alive under Lor’themar’s regency.
title: Chapter 2: Hunger in the Ashes
